title: Power Cycle
intro: Power Cycle: an 8-week strength and power cycle for when you want to get heavier and faster. Four training days plus an optional Zone 2 day.

Each day opens with a contrast pair: a heavy lift (A1) followed by a fast, light explosive move (A2) that uses the same pattern. The heavy set wakes up the nervous system, the jump or throw teaches you to use it.

A1 runs in waves: week 1 sets of 5, week 2 sets of 4, week 3 sets of 3 (heaviest), week 4 a lighter week of 5s at about 70%. Weeks 5-7 repeat the wave with new lifts, week 8 you build to a heavy triple.
After the contrast pair: a hypertrophy superset (B) at 8-10 reps, then short, sharp conditioning: sprints, EMOMs, gymnastics. Rest fully between heavy sets: 2 minutes is the minimum.
Tempo: 4 digits. 1st = lowering (seconds), 2nd = pause at the bottom, 3rd = lifting (X = explode), 4th = pause at the top.
Best after the Foundation or Contrast Cycle. Week 9: deload.
